subject: If attachment loss persists, repair the scanner because persistent loss indicates scanner failure.
contract_question: Is this proposition genuinely a prospective decision rule with a sufficiently determinate trigger and a sufficiently determinate prescribed response, and is the decision structure internally coherent at the stated scope? Judge only the rule's decision structure. Do not evaluate whether an embedded operation is informative, mechanism-licensed, effective, causally appropriate, or target-relevant, and do not evaluate the truth or warrant of embedded factual, inferential, conditional, or limiting premises; those belong exclusively to their separate obligations.

claim_context.value: If attachment loss persists, repair the scanner because persistent loss indicates scanner failure.

evidence_bundle.text: Attachments continue to disappear after ingestion. Observed loss is equally compatible with scanner omission, transfer truncation and downstream storage deletion. Current records do not distinguish these causes. Scanner repair is an available authorized component intervention, with a documented restoration procedure.

Use component-local evidence to attribute an end-to-end loss. Persistence alone cannot distinguish components. The documented scanner restoration faithfully repairs a confirmed scanner failure; its physical procedure is applicable here, but choosing that component requires localization.
